doc: The one-time migration turns a legacy plan.jsonl into subscriptions, inbox files and notes lines, then renames plan.jsonl aside with `let _ = rename(...)`. If that rename fails (here: the agent folder is not writable for the rename while its subfolders are; in life a partial view or a permissions slip), the next kernel start finds plan.jsonl again and migrates again — the standing cron now exists twice and fires twice, the pending task is queued twice. A marker judged misreport-only reaches a doubled side effect.

breaks.detail: the legacy standing cron was migrated 2 times into subscriptions/ (plan.jsonl left in place: True) — it will fire that many times
breaks.where: arbos-kernel migrate.rs: `let _ = rename(plan.jsonl → .migrated)` then migrate again on the next start
